title: Jamaican Hash Brown Crusted Duck
description: A Jamaican inspired dish featuring a crispy hash brown crust on a duck breast. Perfect for a special occasion dinner.
instructions: Season the duck breast with salt and black pepper.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the duck breast until browned on both sides.
Transfer the duck to a baking sheet.
Mix the jamaican hash and grated potatoes in a bowl.
Spread the hash brown mixture evenly over the duck breast.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the duck is cooked through and the crust is golden brown.
Let the duck rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
